audios.path: ##_draftpath_placeholder_0E685133-18CE-45ED-8CB8-2904A212EC80_##/成仙模拟 1-20合集 新手村篇 [BV1MTL56fErE].f30280.m4a

texts.content: <font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我被聊天群随意丢到修仙界]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这里遍地是坑]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[稍不留神就死无葬身之地]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[幸好我有人生模拟器]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[每天可以免费普通模拟]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[也可以花费零食进行特殊模拟]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有概率获得模拟天赋]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[还能从特殊模拟里法宝修为]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[天赋中任选其一在此时]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[咋样新人抽到了什么金手指]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[让大伙开开眼杯]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[该不会是和我一样]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[抽到了个垃圾金手指]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[直接自闭了吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[金手指这种是莫抢球]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有总比没有来的强]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[为啥你们就默认]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[新人抽到的金手指是垃圾]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[难道就不能是抽到了牛逼金手指]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[而处于狂喜状态吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[胡子说的有道理你们这群人啊]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[大大的坏]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[蔡哥你有资格说这话吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你入群最早]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[还被修仙宗门长老硕为弟子]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[太让人羡慕了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[抱歉啊话说新人获得了什么能力]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[呃我我能看见未来]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[哎这森林里的妖兽可真多]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[还好我有模拟器]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[才能找到这个民风淳朴的尺寸]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你好我叫落落]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[意外来到这里]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[请村长收留我一段时间]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[来日必有重谢]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[哈哈我们这村子远离喧嚣]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[鲜有人能来这里]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你能安然无恙的来到这里]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[也算是运道不错]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[和我们村也算是有点缘分]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[让你入住一段时间也未尝不可]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[多谢不必客气]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[随老朽来吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我带你去找个住处]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这小子虽然是个弱鸡]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[但这运气还真不错]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[一个人在这黑风森林之中逃跑]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[居然没有被妖兽吃掉]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[亦或者被毒虫咬死]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[小友不知你来自哪里]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[老朽对外面还是有些了解的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我来自白河镇]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[是白河镇布加的大少白河镇吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[以后若是有村里人出去]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我会让他带你离开这里的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[多谢村长]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[年轻人你体魄看起来不是很好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[没有入伍的话]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[独自在这黑风森林之中很危险]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村长教训的是我以后不会乱跑了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[对了村长您觉得我现在还能练武吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你年龄大了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[练武也太晚了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[即便你在药物的浸泡下强行练武]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[未来也难有大成就]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[顶多就是强身健体罢了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[哎当然你也不必灰心]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[练武有练武的好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[当个普通人也有普通人的好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有些时候]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[平平静静的过完一辈子]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[或许要比踏入修行界]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[天天打生打死来的强吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村长说的是]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不过]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这次经历让我知道了练武的重要性]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[所以我还是会努力练武]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你这次死里逃生的确是个教学]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有实力傍身]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[行走江湖的确安全线]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[若是你的运道好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[获得一些补足先天之本]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[且改善资质的保药]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[未来或许也有走上修行路]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[好了你便住这里吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[顺便帮老朽照顾下一个孩子]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[孩子恩]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[他叫赤峰]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[父母因为一场狩猎去世了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[因为父母的突然离世]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[他伤心过度变得沉默寡言起来]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[掌日窝在屋里]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你是外界来的人]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[看样子是读过书的文化人]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[希望你能帮我开导下这孩子]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[既然是村长所托]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[那我自然是尽力而为嗯]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[赤峰爷爷给你带了个客人回来]</size></color></font>

<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[哪怕是肉体被毁灭了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[若是运气好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[也能养张一些养魂的灵气狗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[活鱼事件]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我看过宗门的古籍]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[些老怪物就是靠着残魂苟活]</size></color></font>

<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不愧是玄幻世界]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[夺舍都跑出来了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[默默的吐槽一句]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[奇幻世界也有夺舍一说吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[那是魔法师的事情]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[和我歧视有何关系]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不管是玄幻世界还是奇幻世界]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[都令人向往而又敬畏啊]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[两个世界的力量都很强]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[而且各种手段防不胜防]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我可以去死]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[但若是被人夺舍]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[那真就太悲惨了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[还好吧虽然可以夺射]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[但每个人的灵魂烙印]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[没那么容易清晰]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[强行夺射的结局]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[只有可能是两个灵魂相融]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[变得疯疯癫癫]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[到时候那个新的灵魂]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[只能说是混杂之物罢了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[所以不到万不得已的时候]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[岳云静的修饰]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[是不可能夺舍其他人的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[500年吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[赤家的仇人起码是千年以前的人物]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[为何能活到现在]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[将赤村人全部弄消失]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[还是说]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[并非我想象中的赤家仇人所谓]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[而是另有隐情]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[亦或者说赤家的仇敌]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[靠夺舍重修活了千年以上]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[如今的修为]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[更是已经凌驾于超凡大境之上了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村长我有件事想和你说]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你要离开了吗]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村长你是怎么知道的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你的体质特殊]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[注定需要大量的零食辅助修行]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[所以你注定是要离开尺寸的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不过这样也好]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[比起尺寸外面才更适合你]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我们这村子只适合饮食养老啊]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这样我只希望你离开之后]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不要将村子的事情说出去]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我不会说出去的]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[而且]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我也会让你没有足够自保的能力]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我相信你]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村长赤峰应该是有潜在灵体]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[村子里有没有让他觉醒的功法]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有也没有什么意思]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我们赤村的火灵爵]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[曾经是一部地级功法改编而来]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[而那部功法]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[就是曾经的赤族人专修的功法]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不过他遗失了大部分残缺很严重]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[无法修行]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这也是为何改编功法的原因]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[原来如此]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[关于李家]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我这次出去]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[会让他们失去威胁尺寸的力量]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[什么等等]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你的修为越有突破]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这是凌源静]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[现在的我有能力灭了李家]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[等我灭了李家]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[尺寸就能安全度日了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你的体质如此]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[特殊还是在修炼一段时间]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[等到彻底无敌再去找李家的麻烦]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我们尺寸已经欠你太多恩情了]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[真的不想你因为我们而出事]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[放心吧我心中有数落落]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[你且随我来吧]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[有两个东西]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[或许对你有着不小的帮助]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这是什么]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[这是我尺寸的传承之物]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[也是组长的信物]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[唯有族长知晓其秘密]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[在灭族那日]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[族长只来得及让我带着这东西]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[以及族内少部分人从暗道里逃出去]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[我虽然]</size></color></font>
<font id="" path="D:/Program Files/CapCut/1.5.0.230/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"><color=(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)><size=5.000000>[不知道这枚古域隐藏着什么秘密]</size></color></font>
